# Eukleya

> Let your work speak well of you.

Eukleya is an AI-powered resume analyzer. Upload a resume (PDF) and get
instant feedback on ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compatibility, tone and
style, structure, content, and skill matching -- optionally tailored to a
specific job by filling in a job title/description, or by auto-filling them
from an uploaded job posting file (PDF, DOCX, or an image/screenshot).

Free to try: a 3-day trial, no credit card required. Sign in with email and
password or with Google.

## Key pages

- Home: https://eukleya.chizalabs.com/
- Sign up: https://eukleya.chizalabs.com/signup
- Sign in: https://eukleya.chizalabs.com/signin
- Privacy Policy: https://eukleya.chizalabs.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://eukleya.chizalabs.com/terms

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Eukleya is operated by Chiza Labs.
- The product analyzes resumes the user explicitly uploads; it does not
  scrape or source resumes from anywhere else.
- Feedback is AI-generated and provided for informational purposes only --
  not professional career, legal, or hiring advice.
- /dashboard, /upload, /resume/*, and /subscribe require a signed-in account
  and are intentionally excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt).
